 O R D E R The claim petition filed by the petitioners U/S 166 of MV Act is hereby partly allowed with costs.
The petitioners are entitled for compensation of Rs.22,53,000/(Rupees twenty two lakhs fifty three thousand only), along with the interest at the rate of 6% per annum, from the date of petition till the date of deposit.
The respondents are jointly and severally liable to pay the compensation.
In view of the valid insurance policy, the respondent No.2 being the insurance company shall pay the compensation amount with interest @ 6% P.A. from the date of petition till the date of deposit to the petitioner within two months from the date of this order.
Out of the compensation amount awarded to the petitioners together with interest, the petitioner No.1 is entitled the share of 40%.
And the petitioner No.2 is entitled the share of 60%.
After deposit of the compensation amount together with interest, the petitioner No.1 & 2, shall deposit 40% out of their share, in any Nationalized/Scheduled bank of their choice, for a period of 3 years.
And remaining 60% shall be released to them through due process of law.
Advocate fee is fixed at Rs.500/.
Draw award accordingly.
